operation.description: Returns a list of webhook deliveries for a webhook configured in a repository.
operation.summary: List deliveries for a repository webhook

#/components/parameters/cursor.description: Used for pagination: the starting delivery from which the page of deliveries is fetched. Refer to the `link` header for the next and previous page cursors.
#/components/parameters/cursor.name: cursor

#/components/parameters/hook-id.description: The unique identifier of the hook. You can find this value in the `X-GitHub-Hook-ID` header of a webhook delivery.
#/components/parameters/hook-id.name: hook_id

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/parameters/webhook-delivery.description: Returns webhook deliveries filtered by delivery outcome classification based on `status_code` range. A `status` of `success` returns deliveries with a `status_code` in the 200-399 range (inclusive). A `status` of `failure` returns deliveries with a `status_code` in the 400-599 range (inclusive).
#/components/parameters/webhook-delivery.name: status

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.

#/components/schemas/hook-delivery-item.description: Delivery made by a webhook, without request and response information.

action.description: The type of activity for the event that triggered the delivery.

delivered_at.description: Time when the webhook delivery occurred.

event.description: The event that triggered the delivery.

guid.description: Unique identifier for the event (shared with all deliveries for all webhooks that subscribe to this event).

id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook delivery.

installation_id.description: The id of the GitHub App installation associated with this event.

redelivery.description: Whether the webhook delivery is a redelivery.

repository_id.description: The id of the repository associated with this event.

status.description: Describes the response returned after attempting the delivery.

status_code.description: Status code received when delivery was made.

throttled_at.description: Time when the webhook delivery was throttled.

#/components/schemas/hook-delivery-item.title: Simple webhook delivery
